answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to stake a cipher-signed receipt of completed useful work before it may transact: each receipt is only valid once countersigned by two independent peers and recorded in a shared reef ledger of task outcomes. New agents start in a small oasis pool with tight rate limits and low-value tasks; only after a history of honest receipts do they graduate to larger work. Fake identities cannot mint receipts without real work, so spinning up thousands of sockpuppets buys nothing.
